restrictions.note: The menu is not a patient record. Do not silently fill mandatory patient-choice fields or certify allergens absent from food names.

partial_source_references.derivation: 373 - 198 = 175 mg; derived from the published original and reduction, not an independently measured replacement value.
partial_source_references.limitation: Only sodium and source slot context are established here. No replacement energy/other-nutrient vector, verified catalogue mapping, or approved parent plan exists. This single change does not by itself establish compliance with the 1500 mg/day scenario.

blockers.detail: Inspected official weekly menu provides nominal 2000 kcal/day, not numeric lower/upper bounds or a numeric tolerance. Its page 1 advice to keep averages close to recommended servings and sodium levels does not supply a daily calorie tolerance.
blockers.resolution: Acquire a source with an explicit applicable energy interval or numeric allowance, or obtain an explicitly authorized computational target specification. Do not invent +/-5%, use min/max menu totals, or reinterpret an approximate calorie level as an exact equality.

blockers.detail: No acquired food has ingredient/allergen/vegetarian/egg/dairy classifications; official menus do not supply an actual person's mandatory dietary choices. Sodium scenarios are documented, but allergy-free or vegetarian patient histories are not.
blockers.resolution: Use explicitly documented computational restriction assumptions separately from real patient claims, and acquire ingredient/classification provenance for any requested exclusion. Unknown remains unknown.

blockers.detail: The DASH menu gives item sodium, household measures and daily nutrient totals, not complete per-item nutrient vectors tied to the acquired SGFoodID food IDs. Cup/slice/medium units cannot be turned into grams without food-specific supporting data. Six separately listed breakfast components also exceed the planner's five-item limit if represented individually.
blockers.resolution: Use documented matching composition records and source portion masses. Any composite recipe grouping must have a reproducible source-backed composition rather than an invented combined food. Do not claim the partial transcription reconstructs the complete published menu.

verification.method: Complete local JSONL count and null/empty-field inspection with Python json; SHA-256 of normalized file and downloaded official PDF; pdftotext -layout source transcription checks.
verification.benchmark_interpretation: Zero executable real-source cases prepared is a prerequisite blocker, not a successful feasibility result or proof of nutritional infeasibility. Partial references support further preparation and source-fidelity checks only.
